input: Write a thank-you note to my mentor

gold.taskTitle: Write a thank-you note to your mentor
gold.taskDescription: Compose a meaningful thank-you note addressed to the user's mentor.

questions.title: What specific thing are you thanking your mentor for?
questions.description: Identify the particular action, advice, or support that prompted this thank-you note.

questions.title: How long have they been mentoring you?
questions.description: Understand the length and depth of the mentoring relationship to set the right tone.

questions.title: What format should the note take?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a handwritten card, a typed letter, an email, or a message.

questions.title: What tone do you want: formal, warm, or casual?
questions.description: Establish the voice and register that fits the relationship and occasion.

questions.title: How long should the note be?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a brief few lines or a longer, more detailed message.

questions.title: Is there a specific outcome or impact you want to highlight?
questions.description: Identify any personal growth, achievement, or change the user wants to attribute to the mentor.

questions.title: When does this note need to be ready?
questions.description: Understand the deadline or occasion driving the timing of the note.
